description: Deletes a Sentry monitor, or optionally only its specified environments, for a given project.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for deleting a Sentry monitor or its specific environments.

environment.description: Optional. A list of environment names. If provided, only the monitor configurations for these specific environments will be deleted. If this parameter is omitted or an empty list is passed, the entire monitor and all its environment configurations will be deleted.
environment.title: Environment

monitor_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry monitor to be deleted.
monitor_id_or_slug.title: Monitor Id Or Slug

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization to which the project and monitor belong.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry project to which the monitor belongs.
project_id_or_slug.title: Project Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: DeleteProjectMonitorRequest

name: delete_project_monitor

DeleteProjectMonitorResponse.description:
Response schema for the `DeleteProjectMonitor` action.

Empty response body. The DELETE operation returns HTTP 202 (Accepted) with no content
when successful, indicating the deletion request has been accepted for processing.
DeleteProjectMonitorResponse.title: DeleteProjectMonitorResponse
